text:
sarah.ae: Hey team — running a late-stage POC with a regulated FinTech. They need SOC 2 Type II report, a pen-test confirmation letter, and ISO27001 evidence before legal will sign. Also, they insist the POC runs in their VPC (on-prem/private). Can we provide these?

matt.se: We can share SOC 2 Type II report and a scoped pen-test letter (requires NDA). ISO27001 — we're still in progress on certification, but we can provide our risk assessment and controls mapping doc.

jenny.security: Confirming: SOC2 Type II report — yes (redacted). Pen test letter — security can produce a vendor attestation summarizing findings + remediation status, but only after legal signs an NDA. ISO27001 certificate — we don't have one yet; provide controls mapping + evidence pack (logs, access reviews, policy docs).

sarah.ae: Customer asked whether the pen-test letter can be signed by our external tester or if an internal attestation is ok. Also pricing question: if POC needs private deployment, will that change the quote materially?

matt.se: For the pen-test letter, external tester signature is ideal. We can ask our pen-test vendor for a one-page attestation. Pricing: private VPC POC will require a Dedicated seat — estimate: 1 GPU node reserved for the POC + networking setup. I can ballpark a temporary POC rate (discounted) — need infra to confirm.

jenny.security: Action items: 1) Send NDA template to customer, 2) request pen-test vendor for attestation, 3) assemble SOC2 redacted bundle. I can own #2 and #3. Timeline: SOC2 bundle & pen-test attestation ~ 3-7 business days after NDA. Controls mapping for ISO artifacts ~ 5-10 business days.

sarah.ae: Thanks. Customer also wants a checklist of exactly what we'll hand over so their audit team can prep. Can we provide a clear list?

jenny.security: Yes — here's a short checklist we can share (redacted where required):

```
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted)
- Pen test attestation letter from external vendor (after NDA)
- Controls mapping spreadsheet (ISO27001/ SOC mapping)
- Access control policy & last 6 months of access review logs (export)
- Company security policies (incident response, change mgmt, data retention)
- Encryption key management overview (KMS/HSM)
- Data flow diagram for POC topology
- Hosting location and network isolation details (VPC config snapshot)
```

matt.se: I'll draft the POC pricing notes for a private deployment: include one-time setup fee for VPC peering/VPN, temporary reserved capacity rate, and hourly overage. We can offer a 30% POC discount for 30 days if legal signs NDA and we get a scoping call this week.

paul.eng: Heads-up — engineering needs 48-72 hours to provision a private POC node once we have access IPs and an approved onboarding checklist. Also need to confirm that the model artifacts used in the POC are allowed for private export (some models have licensing constraints).

sarah.ae: Great — I'll ask customer to run through the NDA and send us the contact for IPs. Jenny, can you start collecting the SOC2 redacted bundle and pen-test vendor contact? Matt, please post the draft POC quote in the thread when ready.

jenny.security: On it. Uploading SOC2 redacted bundle to secure share and will post link after NDA: https://internal-shared/reports/SOC2/redacted (will be access-controlled).

matt.se: Draft quote: ``POC Private Deployment — 1x GPU node, 30-day trial, setup $2,500, temporary reserved rate $X/hr (30% discount applied).`` Will attach detailed line items in the next message.

sarah.ae: Perfect. If we can get the NDA signed this week, we should be able to meet the customer's audit timeline. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
